newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Pegasus offers 180.3 mln shrs at HK$1.08 each.
newsitem.headline: HK's Pegasus offers 180.3 mln shrs at HK$1.08 each.

text.p: Hong Kong sports shoes maker Pegasus Holdings Ltd plans to offer 180.3 million new shares, or 25 percent of expanded share capital, in an initial public offering at HK$1.08 per share, the company said on Monday.
The public offer will open from Tuesday to Friday and dealing in shares is expected to begin on October 11, it said.
The company said proceeds would be used mainly to expand its production facility in China and to add four more production lines to the existing 23 lines.
It will also use part of the proceeds to repay bank borrowings, and the remainder for working capital, it added.
The company forecast a profit of not less than HK$118 million for the year ending December 31, 1996, up about 82 percent from 1995 earnings of HK$64.9 million.
Pegasus makes athletic footwear, sports sandals and leisure-wear shoes. Its major customers include Nike, Airwalk, Simple, Teva, Dr Scholl's, Guess and Hang Ten.
Yuanta Securities (Hong Kong) Co Ltd is the sponsor and manager of the issue.
